# @ubgo/crypt (crypt-ts)

> A TypeScript / Node.js cryptography library: AES-256-GCM and ChaCha20-Poly1305 authenticated encryption, HMAC and Ed25519 signing, HKDF key derivation, key rotation, time-locked tokens, and X25519 sealed-box asymmetric encryption — with safe defaults over node:crypto and byte-for-byte interop with the Go counterpart github.com/ubgo/crypt.

@ubgo/crypt is open source (ubgo/crypt-ts), Apache-2.0 licensed. It is a library, not a service: it wraps Node's standard-library node:crypto — no third-party runtime dependencies, no network calls, nothing sent anywhere. Dual-published as ESM and CommonJS with strict TypeScript types.

## Install
- `npm install @ubgo/crypt` (or `pnpm add` / `yarn add`; requires Node.js 18+)

## Links
- Repository: https://github.com/ubgo/crypt-ts
- Go counterpart (byte-for-byte interoperable): https://github.com/ubgo/crypt
